senses.definition: A light tan colour, chiefly with reference to cosmetic powder.

quotes.text: This powder is the finest face powder extant […] In three shades—white, pink, and rachel (for brunettes).
Her dark skin was creamed a thick pale olive matt and thickly powdered with a pale rachel powder […].
